import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
 sc=[c for c in d.columns if c.startswith('sched_dep')][0]; ac=[c for c in d.columns if c.startswith('actual_dep')][0]
 x=d[~d.cancelled].copy(); raw=(pd.to_datetime(x[ac],format='%H:%M')-pd.to_datetime(x[sc],format='%H:%M')).dt.total_seconds()/60
 print(f, 'completed',len(x),'raw min',raw.min(),'max',raw.max(),'negatives',raw[raw<0].sort_values().head(10).tolist())
 rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'id':x.flight_id,'raw':raw,'carrier':f}))
allx=pd.concat(rows)
print('all',len(allx),'raw stats',allx.raw.describe().to_string())
print(allx.sort_values('raw').head(20).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, glob
parts=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
 sc=next(c for c in d if c.startswith('sched_dep')); ac=next(c for c in d if c.startswith('actual_dep'))
 x=d[(~d.cancelled) & d[ac].notna()].copy()
 raw=(pd.to_datetime(x[ac],format='%H:%M')-pd.to_datetime(x[sc],format='%H:%M')).dt.total_seconds()/60
 # clock rollover: only very large negative differences indicate next-day departure; preserve modest early departures
 delay=raw.where(raw>=-720,raw+1440)
 parts.append(pd.DataFrame({'delay':delay,'raw':raw,'carrier':f}))
z=pd.concat(parts,ignore_index=True)
print('n',len(z),'sum',z.delay.sum(),'mean',z.delay.mean(),'rounded',round(z.delay.mean(),1),'rollovers',(z.raw< -720).sum())
print(z.groupby('carrier').agg(n=('delay','size'),avg=('delay','mean'),sum=('delay','sum')).to_string())
print(z[z.raw < -720].sort_values('raw').to_string(index=False))
